name: Busa Product Hub
description: Product & certification hub for export/trade sellers: catalog/SKU master data, pricing, inventory, channel status (Amazon/Shopify/TikTok Shop/eBay), content readiness, compliance notes, lifecycle state, a certificate expiry tracker (CE/FCC/RoHS/UN38.3/UKCA), and an approval-gated review queue (channel publish approvals, price-change review, quality holds, lifecycle decisions, and unsourced spec claims). The AirApp itself only ever decides on a review item (approve/request_changes/block) directly onto its own record -- it never creates a product, channel, inventory, or certificate row.

agentPrompts.label: Give me the product hub overview
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then give me the overview: active product count, average margin, inventory value, certificates at risk, and what's waiting in the review queue.

agentPrompts.label: Ingest a marketplace export or spec sheet
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then run `scripts/ingest_products.mjs` with the product/channel/inventory/certificate payload I prepared, upserting by natural key so re-ingests stay idempotent. Never invent a fact the source document doesn't contain.

agentPrompts.label: What am I not ready to answer at the trade show?
agentPrompts.body:
{target}

Read the `busa-product-hub` skill in this folder, then tell me which products have missing or soon-to-expire certificates, unsourced spec claims, or incomplete content, so I know what to fix before I'm asked about it in person.
